responsibility: Handles native CPU detection for the LoongArch target using the cpucfg instruction. It reads and caches selected hardware configuration words, derives native ISA and FPU properties, cache geometry, and processor identification, maps known PRIDs to GCC CPU tune types such as LA464, and fills the CPU_NATIVE property tables that option handling and tuning code use for -march=native and -mtune=native.
same_name_distinction: Implements the native CPU probing logic for the loongarch-cpu pair: it executes cpucfg, caches hardware words, decodes PRID/ISA/cache data, and populates CPU_NATIVE tables. Unlike loongarch-cpu.h, this is the target-code runtime implementation rather than the interface declaration.
